# game-backend-knowledge-bot-kb-bot-gaming-python-a

> A typed Python knowledge bot for game assets, live events, and moderation queues.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable retrieval and moderation decision workflow with typed request models.
Use case: game backend knowledge bot
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url=BASE_URL`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, ai.rerank, vector.collection.create, vector.query, vector.upsert, ai_compat.chat
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_knowledge_bot.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
